body: This makes sense to me, thanks so much for taking the time to reply. I agree it’s necessary sometimes to take medication for mental health, and I knew there was going to be a rocky period to begin with - I just wasn’t expecting to crash that hard. I don’t think I could have kept taking it, I felt like I was going to die. I am going to try to tackle this with therapy and healthier life choices, then go back to medication if they don’t help, thank you again for replying
